decisions.reason: The mild sliced cheese builds directly on the firm's in-house cheesemaking know-how and serves an established retail category, so the firm can read its early sales signals and refine it with its own R&D, which favours keeping it after only one year on the market.

The sliced butter cheese draws on the same core dairy and cheesemaking knowledge and the same organic sourcing network, so it carries little absorptive risk and the firm can assimilate market feedback quickly; despite the recent withdrawal of the yogurt line, keeping it is the sensible course.
